title: Can I BEAT Shotgun King? [RANK 4]
summary: Shotgun King, Rank 4: instead of new white pieces, white's strategy/AI improves by one level. He has only the default shotgun ('the Solomon'), turns off flashing lights, and clears all floors (cards incl. Holy Gunpowder +1 firepower vs Cardinal; Manganel; Succubus/extra queen; Lady in the Tower; 'extra turn after using a soul card'; 'charge one additional shell'; '-1 fire range but protect from death once per floor'; 'replace knights, bishops and rooks with pawns after they die'), unlocking rank 4 and an achievement for finishing a floor moving only with souls.
rules: Shotgun King: The Final Checkmate (Steam roguelike). You are the lone black king with a shotgun; white's army (led by the White King) is on each floor's irregular board (holes/gaps possible).

Turn: either move one square like a king, or fire the shotgun (a spread of pellets in the aimed direction with limited range; damage depends on firepower and distance/focus). Moving reloads a shell; reloading without moving can squeeze in one extra shell with some cards.

White pieces move by normal chess rules (one white piece moves per turn, AI-chosen); squares they attack are marked; ending your turn on an attacked square = captured (death) unless protected by a card.

Kill the White King to clear the floor; Throne mode = clear floors 1-12 (or as shown); 'Rank' = difficulty level unlocked after clearing (each rank adds a handicap such as extra white pieces or stronger white strategy).
Between floors you pick one of two card pairs: a black (player) upgrade bundled with a white (enemy) buff, e.g. Holy Gunpowder (+1 firepower) with Cardinal (remove a pawn, add a bishop, -1 max ammo).
Soul cards: killing a piece can grant its 'soul' - a one-shot move as that piece (e.g. soul of the bishop/knight lets your king move like that piece once).
Rank 4 handicap: white's AI strategy +1 (smarter), no new pieces.

Cards seen: Holy Gunpowder (+1 firepower) / Cardinal (white: -1 pawn +1 bishop, you -1 max ammo); browse-and-pick any card / Manganel (white); flip-card if a piece is adjacent; Succubus, extra queen (white); extra turn after using a soul card / Lady in the Tower (white); reload-without-moving adds a shell; -1 fire range but protected from death once per floor; replace a white card; white knights, bishops and rooks are replaced by pawns after they die (white card).
win_condition: Clear all floors of the Throne run at Rank 4 (killing the White King each floor).
